new: Tech leaders have nonetheless underlined their safety commitments, with Altman, Amodei and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk voicing support in October 2026 for an industrywide slowdown in AI development, according to CBS News.[^2]

support.quote: As scrutiny of their tech's safety grows, tech leaders have underlined their safety commitments.
